scope: Read-only offline analysis of four real normal-CUDA-Graph MTP4 Nsight Systems 2026.5.1 captures. Kernel-name opportunities are inferred; no GPU run or service change.
denominator_rule: Each share divides by sum of durations of all selected GPU kernels in that one capture. GPU memcpy and memset are separate and not included in kernel denominator. Sum duration is not wall time or HTTP latency.
upper_bound_rule: Deleting 100% of selected kernel GPU duration with zero replacement cost gives only an optimistic ceiling on captured GPU-kernel-sum reduction; it is neither an achievable optimization nor a bound on end-to-end HTTP latency. Fused buckets are already fused and cannot be called unfused launch opportunity.
captured_window_rule: Prefill traces are 19K-token fresh prompts/1 completion; decode traces start after first streamed text, NVTX generation-only; neither covers a full 256-token request duration.
